verdict.rationale: Airweave's documented architecture is the reverse of this story: it exposes its own MCP server (docs-5, probe-3) so external AI agents (Cursor, Claude, etc.) can call ITS tools, and it connects to third-party apps via its own 'source connections' and auth providers (docs-2, docs-10) rather than by consuming other MCP servers. No evidence shows Airweave itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in and uses tools from external MCP servers. Missing for 10: any documentation or example of Airweave importing/connecting to third-party MCP servers and invoking their tools.
